name: OTA Update via HTTP Request
description: The OTA (Over The Air) via HTTP Request update component allows your devices to install updated firmware on their own. To use it, in your device's configuration, you specify a URL from which the device will download the binary file (firmware). To trigger the update, an ESPHome [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) is used which initiates the download and installation of the new firmware. Once complete, the device is rebooted, invoking the new firmware.
